_readme: The channel's recurring generated character. Runway pins a person across shots from a reference image, so every generated clip shows the same woman rather than a new stranger. Cast candidates with the 'Cast recurring character' workflow, then commit the chosen portrait into this repo and name it in approved_file. Runway's own asset URLs expire within a day or two, so the portrait is a committed file sent inline at generation time; approved_url stays available for a durable URL you host yourself. Generation refuses to run until one of them is set.
notes: An ordinary woman in her mid-thirties, calm and capable, unstyled. She is synthetic: no real person is depicted, and no claim is ever made that she is a real customer or trainer.
